subject: Request: IR artifacts, SIG crosswalk, and redacted post-incident package for Nova Holdings
messages:
From: security@novaholdings.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: IR artifacts and SIG mapping for recent outage

Hi Markus,

We’re closing our assessment of the June 12th service degradation and need a few items to complete our vendor risk review and SIG/CAIQ crosswalk: 1) a copy of Redwood’s incident response plan (IRP) with minimal redactions for internal roles/IDs, 2) a sanitized post-incident summary that omits customer PII and telemetry (we can indicate required redaction level), 3) the SIG mapping / CAIQ crosswalk that shows how controls map to your IR steps, and 4) any SOC 2 evidence (sample runbooks, timeline exports) you can share for the June 12 timeframe.

Can you confirm expected delivery timeframe and whether you’ll provide a presigned S3 or secure drive link for sensitive artifacts? Our timeline is tight—executive review next Thursday. If helpful, I’ve looped our external forensics contact, Alex Harris.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Security Program Manager
Nova Holdings
security@novaholdings.com

--
Attachment request: please include filenames in the email rather than embedded files when possible

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: security@novaholdings.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and SIG mapping for recent outage

Thanks Alex — received and understood.

Marissa (Head of Security) and Soojin (IR lead) are the right owners for the artifacts. Marissa — can you confirm what level of redaction we should apply to the IRP and postmortem for Nova (roles-only vs. internal ticket ids removed)? Also confirm whether we can provide a SOC 2 sample bundle for the June 12 window (sanitized).

Target: get an initial redacted package and SIG crosswalk to Alex by EOD Monday so they have time for executive review next week. If we need approvals beyond that, flag here.

-Markus Klein
VP Sales Operations (covering enterprise security requests)
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, security@novaholdings.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and SIG mapping for recent outage

Alex / Markus / Soojin —

We can provide the following to satisfy Nova’s review:

- IRP (redacted): remove internal ticket IDs, replace user/full names with role tags (e.g., "Oncall Engineer") but preserve timelines and escalation paths. File: IRP_redacted_v1.pdf (attaching).
- Post-incident summary (sanitized): high-level timeline, root cause, mitigation steps, and lessons learned; telemetry snippets redacted. File: postmortem_sanitized_v1.docx (attaching).
- SIG/CAIQ crosswalk: control IDs mapped to IR activities and evidence references. File: sig_mapping_20280630.xlsx (attaching).
- SOC 2 sample evidence: a limited bundle — runbook excerpt and timeline export for June 12 (we will provide presigned S3 link). See s3_presigned_instructions.txt for access steps.

Notes / asks from our side:
- Please confirm redaction level (roles-only) is acceptable. If Nova needs more granular logs (IP addresses, full telemetry) we will need a Data Use Addendum and a short access window.
- We will deliver an initial package by Monday 2028-07-02 17:00 UTC.

Attachments referenced (stubs):
- IRP_redacted_v1.pdf (PDF, ~120KB)
- postmortem_sanitized_v1.docx (Word, ~45KB)
- sig_mapping_20280630.xlsx (Excel, ~60KB)
- s3_presigned_instructions.txt (text, access steps)

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0123

> On Jun 30, 2028, at 16:12, security@novaholdings.com wrote:
> Alex Nguyen wrote:
> > We’re closing our assessment of the June 12th service degradation and need a few items to complete our vendor risk review...

From: security@novaholdings.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, alex.harris@forensica.com
Date: 2028-07-01T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and SIG mapping for recent outage

Marissa — this is great, thank you. Roles-only redaction is acceptable for the IRP and postmortem. A few clarifications:

- Can you include the exact timeline for the customer-facing notification and the internal SLA breakpoints (we only need the time windows, not internal IDs)?
- For SOC 2 sample evidence: the compliance team expects a runbook excerpt & a timeline export covering 00:00–08:00 UTC on June 12. A presigned S3 link is perfect; please include expiry details and the object list.

We would prefer the artifacts in a single encrypted archive uploaded to a short-lived S3 presigned URL (48-hour access). Alex (cc) will manage the download and attest to receipt.

Thanks again — if you hit any approvals roadblocks, loop our procurement contact (ciso@novaholdings.com).

—
Alex Nguyen
Security Program Manager
Nova Holdings

Download instructions: see s3_presigned_instructions.txt (attached).

If Nova requires a short NDA addendum for raw telemetry we will prepare it; otherwise the sanitized/tarred package should be sufficient for your compliance review.

Attachments (stubs): redacted_package_nova_20280701.tar.gz (encrypted archive), s3_presigned_instructions.txt

Regards,
Marissa Cole

From: security@novaholdings.com

Received and confirmed — I downloaded the archive successfully (Alex verified checksum). This looks good for our executive review. If procurement needs an NDA addendum we’ll reach back out; otherwise we expect to close the vendor review on Friday. Thanks Marissa and team for the quick turnaround.
